bnpparibas.avature.net exists and **robots.txt disallows it**; group.bnpparibas returns 403 to an honest user agent. Refused on both routes. Verified 2026-09-07.
Confirmed to run an early-careers programme (vault note 14). No ATS board found, and the careers URL is not verified — the guess returned 404. Find the real URL to upgrade this to a page-watcher.

Their board is higher.gs.com/roles and **robots.txt disallows it**. That is a definite answer and a better one than the old 'No ATS' — Goldman is not unreachable, they have said no. Spring week typically opens in the first three weeks of September, so this is a manual checklist item every September.

Three fetches from two paths all timed out — the connection is accepted and then never answered, which is a block wearing a slow hat rather than an outage. UK cycle is separate from the US one, which closed in February. Verified 2026-09-07.
Applications by email only; no vacancy list on the careers page. Check it by hand once a cycle.

Readable and currently SILENT: 160 jobs, **0 early-careers**, all US lateral (Charlotte and New York, VP/Associate). Their campus pipeline is not on this host and is probably on the Disallowed SuccessFactors one. `expect_early_careers=False` so `coverage.gaps` does not report this as a fault — it is a correct silence, not a broken board. Slug mode because the job pages carry schema.org MICRODATA (`<meta itemprop="datePosted">`) and `sitemap._jsonld_jobs` reads JSON-LD only; a microdata fallback would give this board exact dates and is the obvious next increment.

**The most expensive source bell has, and it is a cadence question rather than a bug.** No ETag and no Last-Modified — both checked and absent — so every poll pays 503 KB on the wire (1.77 MB decoded) for a page whose job list is one hidden input. A whole slow pass costs about 1.46 MB over 180 requests, so this single source adds roughly a third again, 96 times a day, for ever. The adapter fingerprints so an unmoved board costs no ingest, but the bytes are spent regardless and B, C and D all run on the same 15-minute pass, so there is no slower tier to put it in. If that is too much, `enabled: false` here and re-enable the disabled `manual` row above.
